records.title: 长干行
records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one full-page background for a Chinese Tang poetry reading app, not a UI mockup. Generate ONE portrait 9:16 image. Refined traditional Chinese watercolor and ink on warm ivory xuan paper, gentle handmade paper grain, restrained grey-green, warm muted ochre. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: ALL painted subjects and details are confined to a shallow vignette in the TOP 20-25% of the whole tall page, dissolving completely into ivory paper by 28% height. The CENTER AND LOWER 70% must be nearly uniform blank warm ivory paper, intentionally empty for typeset poetry. No objects, shadows, branches, clouds or bottom decoration below 30%. Full bleed without borders, picture frames or rectangular boundaries. No text, calligraphy, signature, seal, logos, watermark or UI. Scene: Li Bai's Chang Gan Xing. In an old Jiangnan lane a young adult Tang-dynasty woman in plain graceful hanfu waits beside the threshold of her home for her merchant husband to return. A faint river lane beyond, a little green moss at the doorstep, two tiny butterflies near sparse autumn grasses. Quiet longing and the passage of time. One adult woman only, no children. Keep the figure, doorway, moss and butterflies entirely in the upper quarter; let the bottom of the shallow scene melt into untouched warm paper.
records.visualReview: 门前等候的女子、青苔、两只蝴蝶与远处河巷均限于上方约三成；下方约七成连续暖纸留白，无文字或边框。
